name: bld6_cyclotomic_two_mul_odd_coeff
statement: (n k : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) (h1 : 1 < n) : (Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * n) ℤ).coeff k = (-1) ^ k * (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).coeff k
closed: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) (h1 : 1 < n), (Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * n) ℤ).coeff k = (-1) ^ k * (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).coeff k
informal: Uses Mathlib2.poly_cyclotomic_two_mul_odd_comp_neg: rewrite Φ_(2n) = Φ_n ∘ (-X) and compute the k-th coefficient of p.comp(-X) as (-1)^k p.coeff k (write -X = C(-1)·X and use the coefficient formula for comp with C a * X).
